edition.title: Magnitudo et praestantia — Iohanni Francisco Zelli abbati Sancti Pauli de missa pontificali — Rome: Ex Typographia Polyglotta S. C. de Propaganda Fide, 1902.

work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter LXIV grants Abbot Zelli the faculty to celebrate pontifical Mass at the newly consecrated high altar of St Paul’s; address, intitulation, body and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF14761–14761; the source dating clause at LF14794–14797 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima tertia ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo primo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
